verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of SSR deployment targets, serverless/edge runtime adapters, or zero-config deployment tooling for Vue; it only covers general framework philosophy, reactivity, TypeScript, and community sentiment. Deploying SSR apps to serverless/edge without custom infra is typically the domain of Vue meta-frameworks (e.g., Nuxt), and none of that is evidenced here for Vue.js itself. Missing for 10: any documentation of SSR server-renderer deployment, serverless/edge adapters, or platform-specific zero-config deployment guides.
